english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a person’s emotional excitement or exhilaration.
This is the all-purpose choice for an excited state of intense happiness.
Use this for high-energy, exhilarated elation rather than the calmer joy expressed by 喜悅.

examples.english: I'm already full of excitement about going on a trip tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 聽日去旅行，我而家已經好興奮喇。
examples.jyutping: teng1 jat6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 ngo5 ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 hou2 hing1 fan5 laa3

examples.english: I was filled with euphoria when I received the gift.
examples.traditional: 收到份禮物嗰刻，我真係興奮到瞓唔着。
examples.jyutping: sau1 dou2 fan6 lai5 mat6 go2 hak1 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hing1 fan5 dou3 fan3 m4 zoek6

examples.english: They were so full of elation after hearing they had made the final that they could not sleep all night.
examples.traditional: 聽到自己入選決賽，佢興奮到成晚都瞓唔着。
examples.jyutping: teng1 dou3 zi6 gei2 jap6 syun2 kyut3 coi3 keoi5 hing1 fan5 dou3 sing4 maan5 dou1 fan3 m4 zoek6
